findings.message: 51 panel borders are dark against their ground: #ffffff on #111318 (18.58:1) | #ffffff on #111318 (18.58:1) | #ffffff on #111318 (18.58:1)
findings.fix: A panel border is a whisper: about 1.1–1.3:1 against its ground on a light screen (#e5e7eb–#ededed on white), and about 1.2–1.5:1 on a dark one (#1a1a1a on #000, #2e2e2e on #111). Darker lines turn the screen into a grid of boxes; keep the stronger line for controls.
Data and labels read at 13–14px; keep 11–12px for sublines and axis ticks.

findings.message: Only 9 of 51 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.

findings.message: 4 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 106px in "Nicolly Sekitani", 106px in "T’ana Adamos", 106px in "Lenox Reyes".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.
An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).
